card.name: Setting up skeptical 'supposed' claims
card.fires_on: Words right after verbs of loud praising or complaining (tout, caterwaul, extol, hailed, proclaimed), where a doubtful or so-called claim is about to follow. Seen in opinionated web prose.

modes.label: Touting verbs
modes.description: The word after or inside a verb of boasting or praising, before the praised thing.
modes.example: As animal activists tout<< the>> supposed superiority of meatless eating, it

modes.label: Complaint or spread verbs
modes.description: The word 'about' after verbs of noisy complaining or spreading stories.
modes.example: most of the people who caterwaul<< about>> being offended are being serious.

modes.label: Praise word partway through
modes.description: Inside or just after praise words such as praised, hailed, extolling, feigned.

card.writes: It pushes words like supposedly, purported, supposed and allegedly, giving a skeptical tone.
card.plain: It spots places where the writer is about to cast doubt on a claimed benefit or praise.
